scheme_name: Asangathit Karmakaar Mrtyu Evan Divyaang Sahaayata Yojana
description:
The Asangathit Karmakaar Mrtyu Evan Divyaang Sahaayata Yojana is a welfare scheme launched by the Government of India to provide financial assistance and support to unorganized workers and their families in the event of death or disability.

This scheme was officially launched on 1st January 2020.

The primary objective of the scheme is to ensure financial security for the families of unorganized workers who face the unfortunate event of death or disability.

The scheme aims to provide a one-time financial assistance of ₹2 lakh to the family of the deceased unorganized worker.

In cases of permanent disability, the scheme offers a financial assistance of ₹1 lakh to the affected individual.

The scheme is specifically designed to cater to the needs of unorganized workers who often lack social security benefits.

Eligibility for this scheme is primarily focused on unorganized workers aged between 18 and 60 years.

The income criteria for eligibility stipulate that the annual income of the unorganized worker should not exceed ₹3 lakh.

The applicant must be a registered unorganized worker under the National Database for Unorganized Workers (NDUW).

To apply for the scheme, the applicant must fill out the prescribed application form available at designated government offices.

The application form requires the applicant to provide personal details such as name, age, address, and details of the unorganized work they are engaged in.

Additionally, the applicant must submit proof of identity such as an Aadhar card or voter ID.

Proof of income must also be submitted to verify that the annual income does not exceed the stipulated limit.

In the event of death, the family members of the deceased worker must provide a death certificate along with the application.

In case of disability, the applicant must provide a medical certificate confirming the nature and extent of the disability.

The application process can be initiated at the local Labour Department office or through designated online portals.

Once the application is submitted, it undergoes a verification process conducted by the concerned authorities.

The timeline for processing applications typically ranges from 30 to 45 days.

Disbursement of financial assistance is made directly to the bank account of the eligible beneficiary.

The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India.

State governments are also involved in the implementation and monitoring of the scheme at the local level.

The scheme is part of a broader initiative to enhance the social security net for unorganized workers in India.

As of October 2023, the government has reported that over 5 lakh unorganized workers have benefited from this scheme since its inception.

The scheme is expected to cover millions of unorganized workers across various sectors including agriculture, construction, and domestic work.

The government has allocated a budget of ₹500 crore for the implementation of this scheme for the financial year 2023-2024.

Awareness campaigns are conducted regularly to inform unorganized workers about the benefits and application process of the scheme.

The scheme also aims to reduce the financial burden on families who lose their primary breadwinners unexpectedly.

The assistance provided under this scheme is intended to help families cope with immediate financial needs such as funeral expenses and other related costs.

The scheme is a significant step towards recognizing the contributions of unorganized workers to the economy.

It also aims to promote the registration of unorganized workers under the NDUW to ensure they receive benefits from various government schemes.

The government encourages local bodies and NGOs to assist in the outreach and registration of unorganized workers.

The scheme is aligned with the broader goals of the Indian government to provide social security and welfare to marginalized sections of society.

The implementation of the scheme is monitored through regular audits and assessments to ensure transparency and accountability.

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected to improve the scheme and address any challenges faced during the application process.

The scheme is part of the larger framework of welfare measures introduced by the Indian government to uplift the living standards of unorganized workers.

The government has also introduced other complementary schemes to provide health insurance and pension benefits to unorganized workers.

The Asangathit Karmakaar Mrtyu Evan Divyaang Sahaayata Yojana is a critical component of these efforts.

The scheme has been well-received by the public and has garnered positive feedback for its timely assistance.

The government continues to refine the scheme based on the evolving needs of unorganized workers.

The scheme is expected to evolve further with the introduction of technology to streamline the application and disbursement processes.

As of October 2023, the government is exploring partnerships with financial institutions to facilitate easier access to funds for beneficiaries.

The scheme reflects the government's commitment to ensuring that no worker is left behind in the pursuit of social security.

The financial assistance provided under the scheme is tax-free and does not affect the eligibility for other welfare schemes.

The scheme's success is measured by the number of beneficiaries and the impact on their livelihoods post-assistance.

Overall, the Asangathit Karmakaar Mrtyu Evan Divyaang Sahaayata Yojana represents a significant advancement in the welfare of unorganized workers in India.
